NOTICE TO INVESTORS

THE UNITS OFFERED HEREBY AND THE COMMON LP UNITS AND CLASS A SHARES REPRESENTED THEREBY ARE SUBJECT TO RESTRICTIONS ON TRANSFERABILITY AND RESALE AND MAY NOT BE TRANSFERRED OR RESOLD EXCEPT AS PERMITTED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT AND THE APPLICABLE STATE AND NON-US.
